description: A Svelte component implementing a sidebar navigation menu with user profile, boards, theme toggle, and navigation links for a task management frontend.

methods.name: gotoBoard
methods.description: Navigates to a specific board by setting the URL query parameter.

methods.name: loadBoards
methods.description: Fetches the list of boards asynchronously and updates the local boards array.

methods.name: closeSidebar
methods.description: Closes the sidebar, used for mobile overlay click.

methods.name: toggleTheme
methods.description: Toggles between light and dark themes, updating classes and local storage.
